requirements.statement: Define and register the immutable Phase 4 host-projection receipt contract before the host engine depends on it, including host identity, adapter and projection mode, frozen origin fingerprints, official and trust identity, complete source-to-destination mapping and hashes, instruction-block fingerprint, reload posture, qualification result, and receipt seal.

path_bindings.ownership_evidence: The design requires a distinct immutable host-projection receipt authority and the existing run-state schema does not own host-specific projection state.

proof_bindings.asserted_behavior: The new host-projection receipt schema and its registry ownership are strictly validated and discoverable.
The registered receipt contract requires the complete frozen identity, mapping, instruction, reload, qualification, and sealing fields without overloading existing schemas.

positive: A separate registered schema owns the complete immutable host-projection receipt contract before the host engine depends on it.

The receipt records host and adapter identity, fixed projection mode, frozen origin run-resolution and project-pack fingerprints, official and trust identity, complete source-to-destination mapping and hashes, instruction-block fingerprint, reload posture, qualification result, and receipt seal.
tailtrail-registry.json registers the new contract and focused registry proof validates both schema ownership and strict discoverability.
negative: Do not overload the existing run-state or bridge schema with host-projection state.
Do not implement the host projection engine, alter host instruction files, wire public Start or MCP routes, or claim Phase 5 distribution and end-to-end proof.
Do not permit the receipt to omit complete mapping and hashes, instruction identity, reload posture, qualification, or its own fingerprint.
